comment: Recorded fixture: Jev pick request/response pair for test/jev-slice2.test.ts. No live key, no network: the HTTP layer is stubbed and replays this document. Two Choice questions: selection over the caller's candidate names (probabilities ARE the ranking) and reason over the closed reason enum.

request.state: Fix the login retry bug in api/auth.py: exponential backoff overshoots after 3 attempts

selection.instructions: Which of these named candidates fits this task best?

reason.instructions: Why does that candidate fit best?

criteria.keyword-match: The winner's name tokens appear in the task text.
criteria.name-order: No task signal distinguished the candidates; stable name order decided.
criteria.single-candidate: Only one candidate was supplied, so it wins by default.
criteria.model-judgment: The model's calibrated judgment selected the winner.
